title: 第7章 好心的国王第8章 天下没有白吃的午餐
content_zh:
第七章好心的国王
继续行走，叶宇轩原本舒展的眉头渐渐紧皱，怎么可能，一个食人花也没有？叶宇轩不禁为自己的收集药材任务能否完成感到忧心。
猛烈的甩了甩头，努力集中注意力，把心头这些乱七八糟的杂念忘却。
因为在叶宇轩肉眼可见的范围内：一个身穿兽皮，手持巨大木棒，身高约两米五，长得十分狰狞的半兽人，此刻正依靠着一颗大树休息。
叶宇轩谨慎的向他走去，然而没走几步，那名半兽人便睁开了双眼，仇恨的看了眼叶宇轩。高举着木棒响其砸来。移动的速度可是比毒蜘蛛快了一倍有余。
看着他快速朝自己奔来，叶宇轩知道又是一个主动攻击的怪物。内心一阵不爽。不过回想起当年玩传奇的情景。好像除了动物都是主动攻击的吧，既然进入的是热血传奇世界，那么也很正常。
看着急速奔来的半兽人，叶宇轩也懒得冲上去。木剑竖立在胸前，以逸待劳。
这半兽人身高体壮，同时挥舞着巨大的木棒，表面上看是凶悍绝伦，如果出现在现实当中，可以想象它那粗大的木棒一棒下来，叶宇轩都不一定接得下。可是受到这个世界规则的束缚，它的攻击速度与他的移动速度一样，都是非常的迟缓。
而且它的智慧又是非常的低下，只知道攻击第一个自己看到的人，如果是组队，一个战士在前，后面跟着法师，道士，杀他如杀鸡一般。
不过在这样的世界，叶宇轩可没有发现能够相信的队友。因此也就谈不上什么队伍了。不过凭借着叶宇轩的实力，再加上200的强化属性，躲避掉半兽人的攻击，还是很有信心的。
依靠着对付毒蜘蛛时候的方法，叶宇轩集中注意力，认真闪躲半兽人的木棒，连衣角都没有给半兽人沾上一丝，就轻易的干掉了他。
看着爆下的100积分。叶宇轩满意的点了点头，继续向里面走去。
对付这些半兽人，叶宇轩只能一个一个的引过来杀掉，幸亏他们不像毒蜘蛛一般群集在一个地方。否则这个任务还真的不太好做。
“死吧。”叶宇轩对着空血的半兽人大喊一声，砍下了最后一剑。
“咚，”半兽人庞大的身躯直直的倒了下去。留下一滩黄金和一把乌黑的木剑。
“哇，”天知道我的辛苦了啊，在最后一个半兽人的时候给我爆装备了啊。捡起100点积分和那把乌黑的木剑查看起来。
“乌木剑攻击4—8，力量+1装备条件15点力量和12点智慧，可兑换积分1000”
“呵呵，不错，居然是把乌木剑，而且还是把极品。”叶宇轩爱不释手的抚摸着这本乌黑光亮的木剑。
随即将赠送的木剑扔进自己的空间，右手紧紧的握住这把乌木剑。感觉自己变的更强了。
拿出手表看了看，果然上面显示着，主线任务一：消灭半兽人10/10，消灭半兽人勇士0/2，积分1600/1000.

主线任务二：僵尸王的头颅0/1。
药师任务：食人花的树叶：2/6，食人花的种子0/4.
铁匠任务：获得十快品质5以上的白银矿0/10。
看着慢慢变的漆黑的天空，刚刚战斗还没有丝毫的感觉，可是这么一闲下来，立即感觉自己的精神已经消耗尽了。实在没有了战斗的欲望和精力。
收拾好东西，叶宇轩继续向比奇城进发。走着走着，突然肚子抗议的叫了起来。这时叶宇轩才想起自己今天还没有吃过东西，特别是经历了巨大的消耗运动。肚子不叫还好，一叫就让叶宇轩受不了。
没办法，叶宇轩停下了脚步，四周看了一眼。这周围的环境尽入他的眼底。
这森林当中，其他不多，不过枯枝干柴可真是不少，叶宇轩很容易的捡了许多，将捡到的干柴枯枝堆在一起，在找了块石头，很快就出现了火焰。接着这堆干柴就迅速的燃烧了起来。
而后，叶宇轩从自己的空间中，将上次抢到的5块鹿肉中的三块放在货架上，烧烤起来。显然是打算用这个来充当晚餐。
不久在火焰的直接熏烤下，香气四射鹿肉烧烤成功了。闻着上面扑鼻的香味，叶宇轩急不可耐的咬了一口，虽然没有调料，但是饥饿了一天的叶宇轩还是觉得这个比山珍海味还要好吃。
一块吃了，叶宇轩感觉到肚子已经不在抗议了。再吃一块感觉已经差不多饱了。将剩下的一块放进字的空间中。看着漆黑的夜色，点缀着稀稀疏疏的几颗星星。
撑着疲惫的身躯，保持着注意力集中，小心翼翼的向比奇城进发。
不知过来多久，在叶宇轩精神快要到达极限的时候，终于看见了比奇城那雄伟的城墙。顿时叶宇轩犹如吃了伟哥一般，精力再次十足，越过森林，在那几千米的旷地上。叶宇轩飞速急奔。眨眼之间就来到了比奇城。
进入城市，立刻奔向中心的那片安全地带。可是来到哪里的叶宇轩无语了。只见那块十平方方米左右的安全地带上。挤满了人。连站一个脚的位置都没有。
吃惊的看着眼前的情景，叶宇轩一阵无语。居然满人了。在四周看看，还有着一群和自己一样遭遇的家伙，站在外面不知所措。
“大家好，”一声洪亮有力的吼声传遍比奇城。这突如其来的响声，令所有人都是一惊。那些熟睡的家伙也尽被惊醒，迷糊的睁开双眼，不知发生了什么。
“我自我介绍一下：本人比奇城国王，今天看着我城中无数勇士在街头留宿，实在是于心不忍，特地空出一块皇店给大家住宿。需要的请速来比奇城王国。先到先得啊。”
听到着激动人心的声音，叶宇轩一马当先的奔了过去。同时还开启了：浮光掠影，只为能够好好的睡上一觉，养精蓄锐。
果然开启浮光掠影的叶宇轩加上一级的基本步法，稳稳的超过众人，成为第一个到达的勇者。！~！

Chapter 7 The Kind King
Continuing to walk, Ye Yuxuan's originally relaxed brows gradually frowned. How could it be possible that there wasn't even a piranha? Ye Yuxuan couldn't help but worry about whether his task of collecting medicinal materials could be completed.
Shaking his head violently, he tried to concentrate and forget the messy thoughts in his mind.
Because within the range that Ye Yuxuan could see with his naked eyes: a very ferocious half-orc wearing animal skin, holding a huge wooden stick, about two and a half meters tall, was resting on a big tree at the moment.
Ye Yuxuan walked toward him cautiously, but after taking a few steps, the orc opened his eyes and glanced at Ye Yuxuan with hatred. He held the wooden stick high and struck it with a bang. The moving speed is more than twice as fast as the poisonous spider.
Seeing him running towards him quickly, Ye Yuxuan knew that it was another monster taking the initiative to attack. I felt unhappy inside.不过回想起当年玩传奇的情景。 It seems that except for animals, everyone takes the initiative to attack. Since we are entering the legendary world of passion, it is normal.
Seeing the orcs rushing towards him, Ye Yuxuan didn't bother to rush forward.木剑竖立在胸前，以逸待劳。
This half-orc is tall and strong, and wields a huge wooden club. On the surface, it looks extremely fierce. If it appeared in reality, it is conceivable that Ye Yuxuan may not be able to catch its thick wooden club once it comes down. However, bound by the rules of this world, its attack speed is the same as his movement speed, which is very slow.
Moreover, its intelligence is very low. It only knows to attack the first person it sees. If it is a team, with a warrior in front, followed by a mage and a Taoist priest, killing him is like killing a chicken.
However, in such a world, Ye Yuxuan found no teammates he could trust.因此也就谈不上什么队伍了。 However, with Ye Yuxuan's strength and 200 enhanced attributes, he is still very confident that he can avoid the orc's attack.
Relying on the method he used to deal with poisonous spiders, Ye Yuxuan concentrated his attention and carefully dodged the orc's wooden stick. He easily killed him without even getting a trace of the orc on his clothes.
看着爆下的100积分。 Ye Yuxuan nodded with satisfaction and continued walking inside.
To deal with these orcs, Ye Yuxuan could only lure them one by one and kill them. Fortunately, they were not clustered in one place like poisonous spiders.否则这个任务还真的不太好做。
"Die." Ye Yuxuan shouted at the half-orc who was empty of blood, and struck the last sword.
"Boom," the half-orc's huge body fell straight down.留下一滩黄金和一把乌黑的木剑。
"Wow," God knows how hard I worked. He gave me equipment when I was the last orc. Pick up the 100 points and the black wooden sword and examine them.
"Ebony sword attacks 4-8, strength +1. Equipment requirements: 15 points of strength and 12 points of wisdom, redeemable for 1,000 points."
"Haha, yes, it's actually an ebony sword, and it's also the best." Ye Yuxuan couldn't put it down, stroking the black and shiny wooden sword.
Then he threw the gifted wooden sword into his own space and held the ebony sword tightly in his right hand.感觉自己变的更强了。
I took out my watch and looked at it. Sure enough, it showed, Main Mission 1: Destroy Orcs 10/10, Destroy Orc Warriors 0/2, Points 1600/1000.
主线任务二：僵尸王的头颅0/1。
Apothecary Quest: Piranha leaves: 2/6, Piranha seeds 0/4.
Blacksmith task: Obtain 0/10 silver ore with quality 5 or above.
Looking at the sky that was slowly turning dark, I didn't feel the slightest bit of fighting just now, but as soon as I took a break, I immediately felt that my energy had been exhausted.实在没有了战斗的欲望和精力。
收拾好东西，叶宇轩继续向比奇城进hair. As I was walking, my stomach suddenly growled in protest. At this time, Ye Yuxuan remembered that he had not eaten anything today, especially after going through a huge amount of exercise. It's okay if his stomach doesn't growl, but Ye Yuxuan can't stand it when it does.
Having no other choice, Ye Yuxuan stopped and looked around.这周围的环境尽入他的眼底。
There were not many other things in this forest, but there were quite a lot of dead branches and dry firewood. Ye Yuxuan picked up a lot of them easily. He piled the dry firewood and dead branches together and looked for a stone. Flames soon appeared.接着这堆干柴就迅速的燃烧了起来。
Then, Ye Yuxuan put three of the five pieces of venison he grabbed last time on the shelf from his own space and started grilling them.显然是打算用这个来充当晚餐。
Soon, under the direct smoke of the flame, the fragrant venison was successfully grilled. Smelling the tangy aroma above, Ye Yuxuan eagerly took a bite. Although there was no seasoning, Ye Yuxuan, who had been hungry for a day, still felt that this was more delicious than delicacies from the mountains and seas.
After eating together, Ye Yuxuan felt that his stomach no longer protested.再吃一块感觉已经差不多饱了。将剩下的一块放进字的空间中。 Looking at the dark night, dotted with a few sparse stars.
He held on to his tired body, kept his concentration, and cautiously headed towards Beach City.
I don’t know how long I have been here, but when Ye Yuxuan’s spirit was about to reach its limit, he finally saw the majestic city wall of Beech City. Suddenly, Ye Yuxuan felt as if he had taken Viagra. He was full of energy again and crossed the forest to the open land of several kilometers. Ye Yuxuan ran quickly.眨眼之间就来到了比奇城。
Entering the city, immediately rush to the safe area in the center.可是来到哪里的叶宇轩无语了。 I saw only a safe area of ​​about ten square meters. It was packed with people.连站一个脚的位置都没有。
Looking at the scene in front of him in surprise, Ye Yuxuan was speechless for a while. It was actually full of people. Looking around, there were a group of guys who were in the same situation as him, standing outside at a loss.
"Hello everyone," a loud and powerful roar spread throughout Beach City. This sudden sound shocked everyone. Those sleeping guys were also awakened and opened their eyes in confusion, not knowing what happened.
"Let me introduce myself: I am the King of Beech City. I couldn't bear to see countless warriors in my city sleeping on the streets today, so I specially set aside a piece of the royal hotel for everyone to stay. If you need it, please come to the Kingdom of Beech City as soon as possible. It's first come, first served."
Hearing the exciting voice, Ye Yuxuan took the lead and ran over. At the same time, it also turned on: Glimpses, just to have a good sleep and recharge.
Sure enough, Ye Yuxuan, who had activated the flash of light and the basic footwork of the first level, steadily surpassed everyone and became the first brave person to arrive. ! ~!
